items.title: Probing DNS at Cloudflare

sentences.en: Probing DNS at Cloudflare.
sentences.zh: 正在探测 Cloudflare 的 DNS。

sentences.en: Imagine this: you’ve just pushed a release.
sentences.zh: 想象一下：您刚刚发布了一个版本。

sentences.en: All the unit tests passed and your dashboards are green.
sentences.zh: 所有单元测试均已通过，您的仪表板显示为绿色。

sentences.en: You sit back to relax but then suddenly your phone starts blowing up: prod is broken.
sentences.zh: 您正坐下来放松，但突然您的手机开始响个不停：生产环境出故障了。

sentences.en: This is something the Cloudflare DNS team has experienced firsthand.
sentences.zh: 这是 Cloudflare DNS 团队亲身经历过的事情。

sentences.en: In one rollout of the service that publishes DNS records to our edge, a scheduling bug let some record changes sit unpublished for hours.
sentences.zh: 在一次将DNS记录发布到我们边缘的服务上线中，一个调度漏洞导致一些记录更改数小时未发布。

sentences.en: The service stayed up and was healthy, but new hostnames were slow to resolve and certificates couldn't be issued until the bug was squashed.
sentences.zh: 服务保持运行且运行状况良好，但新主机名的解析速度较慢，并且在漏洞被修复之前无法颁发证书。

sentences.en: DNS failures are hard to catch because they are slow, spread across the network, and partial in where they cause impact.
sentences.zh: DNS故障很难发现，因为它们速度缓慢，分散在整个网络中，并且影响范围有限。

sentences.en: We needed to figure out a way to test DNS the way customers experience it: constantly, from every data center, and against production.
sentences.zh: 我们需要想办法以客户体验的方式来测试DNS：持续不断地、从每个数据中心、针对生产环境进行测试。

sentences.en: For us, the answer was to extend Flamingo, the end-to-end testing framework we were already using to run hundreds of millions of tests a day against Cloudflare's edge.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，答案是扩展Flamingo，这是我们已经在使用的一套端到端测试框架，每天针对Cloudflare的边缘网络运行数亿次测试。

sentences.en: This post covers how Flamingo's modular design lets us add DNS support, how we measure propagation, and how those measurements now decide whether a release goes ahead or gets rolled back.
sentences.zh: 本文介绍了Flamingo的模块化设计如何使我们能够添加DNS支持，我们如何衡量传播，以及这些衡量指标现在如何决定是继续发布还是回滚。

sentences.en: A little background At Cloudflare we’re obsessed with improving performance and safety for our customers.
sentences.zh: 一点背景介绍在Cloudflare，我们致力于为客户提升性能和安全性。

items.title: Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs?

sentences.en: Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs?.
sentences.zh: 人工智能编码代理在处理非REST API时是否会遇到困难？

sentences.en: Plenty of APIs skip REST conventions.
sentences.zh: 许多 API 不遵循 REST 规范。

sentences.en: Some send every write over POST, and some name every endpoint after an action, like /updateBin or /deleteBin .
sentences.zh: 有些通过 POST 发送每个写入操作，有些则以操作命名每个端点，例如 /updateBin 或 /deleteBin。

sentences.en: On paper, agents should have a harder time with those.
sentences.zh: 理论上，特工应该更难对付这些。

sentences.en: REST maps the intent onto the HTTP method, so changing a record is a PATCH and removing it is a DELETE .
sentences.zh: REST 将意图映射到 HTTP 方法，因此更改记录是 PATCH，删除记录是 DELETE。

sentences.en: In comparison, an RPC-style API makes the agent work out what each endpoint is called and what it does.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，RPC 风格的 API 让代理弄清楚每个端点的名称及其功能。

sentences.en: We expected that to cost agents something, either in failed tasks or in extra calls and tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们预计这会对客服代表造成一定损失，无论是任务失败还是额外的通话和代币。

sentences.en: It didn’t, at least when the agent had the docs.
sentences.zh: 至少在经纪人拿到文件时，情况并非如此。

sentences.en: Across 1,356 runs with six models from two vendors, agents succeeded just as often with REST, POST-only and RPC-style APIs, at the same cost in failed calls and tokens.
sentences.zh: 在对来自两个供应商的六个模型进行的1,356次运行中，代理在REST、仅POST和RPC式API上的成功率同样高，且失败调用和代币的成本也相同。

sentences.en: Without docs, REST won by a wide margin, because agents can guess REST URLs from convention and have no way to guess what a non-REST API calls its endpoints.
sentences.zh: 如果没有文档，REST将以较大优势胜出，因为代理可以根据惯例猜测REST URL，但无法猜测非REST API如何命名其端点。

sentences.en: Where non-REST APIs could trip up an agent “Non-REST” usually changes two things at once.
sentences.zh: 在非REST API可能导致客服代表出错的情况下，“非REST”通常会同时更改两项内容。

sentences.en: It limits the API to GET and POST, and it replaces resource paths with endpoints named after verbs, and either change could cost an agent.
sentences.zh: 它将 API 限制为 GET 和 POST，并将资源路径替换为以动词命名的端点，任何一种更改都可能使代理方付出代价。

sentences.zh: 俄罗斯军舰在疑似乌克兰无人机袭击后于班加西沉没。

sentences.en: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a dramatic night-time explosion and the sinking of the vessel.
sentences.zh: 目前尚无人声称对这艘船只的袭击负责，该船只在返回俄罗斯的途中停靠。一艘停靠在利比亚港口城市班加西的俄罗斯军舰于周日凌晨遭到疑似乌克兰海上无人艇的袭击，造成夜间剧烈爆炸并导致该船沉没。

sentences.en: The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette that had stopped to refuel and take on supplies, according to Libyan officials from the country’s eastern government.
sentences.zh: 据利比亚东部政府的官员称，这次袭击严重损毁了俄罗斯海军护卫舰“Merkury”号，该舰当时正停靠补给燃料和物资。
